svg.text: Tile of 32 rows x 128 bytes at shared offset 0, rows 132 bytes apart
32 rows of 32 words of 4 bytes; a warp reading down a column, one word per lane, has no bank conflict
Logical tile: row, byte within the row
Shared memory: offset of each 128-byte line, bank
Colour is the bank, light (0) to dark (31). Outlined: the first word of each row. Grey: not part of the tile.
Ringed: row 5, bytes 28-31 of the tile is at shared offset 688: the line at 640, bank 12.
